skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid skad cig gis// ngo bo bcom ldan rdo rje phag mo la// rnam pa lcags kyi phag rgod 'jigs rung ba// nad rims gdon bgegs za ba'i nus ldan gyur/ oṃ nir sing yer bhed swā hā: zhes thog mar gdan gcig gi steng du khri phrag gcig bzla ba bsnyen pa dang*/ de rjes rgyun khyer zhogs pa lto stong la brgya rtsa sogs ci nus bzlas la sna bug g.yon du phu tshar gsum gdab/ srung ba byed na shog bu nar mor sngags 'di tshar bdun sogs gang rigs bri/ gla rtsi/ shu dag /btsan dug /a ru ra rnams kyis byug /skud pa kha dog sna lnga la gsham nas bsgril la gdags/ yul khams bsrung na/ dar cog la sngags 'di bri nas rdzas khyab par byug la gzug /gzhan gso na gangs chu bskol grangs la sngags btab nas blud/ skrangs pa 'bur yod pa'i rigs la mtha' mes bskor/ dkyil du sngags bdab bo// lho byang gi gter kha gnyis ldan gyi man ngag lag khyer ma/ : sngags 'di dpal sa skya'i man ngag rgyal po'i dkor mdzod las kyang byis pa'i rims srung du gsungs snang*/ ༈ rims srung khyad par can bzhugs/ jo bo rje nas brgyud pa'i rims srung a li mar grags pa lag len can ni/ tad+ya thā/ a li ta li ha li ha dhā rā ke rak+ṣa/ dz+wa ri na tsan+tu hi ka na tha mi ha ar+ya swā hā 'chang ba po la rims nad thams cad srungs shig rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ zhes bri/ shing kun/ kha che/ yungs dkar/ shu dag /mu zi rnams byugs/ tad+ya thā'i rgyab tu oṃ āḥhūm̐ brtsegs mar bri/ mjug nas yar dril/ rab gnas rang sngags dang rten 'brel snying pos bya/ mi lag mi brgyud par mgul du gdags/ shin tu zab bo// 'di jo bo rje nas brgyud/ zur ngag dbang phun tshogs kyis yol mo sprul skur gsan pa'i lag blangs ma'o// gter kha rnying pa 'ga' re las kyang 'byung gsungs/ ༈ 'brum pa srung ba ni/

rgya shog la gu gul nag po dang rgya snag gis/ oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī ban+ti ye swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pa ra du ye 'chang ba po la 'brum nad thams cad rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ zhes bris la rten 'brel snying po brgya rtsas rab gnas bya/ gsham nas dril/ pho'i dpung pa g.yas dang mo'i dpung pa g.yon du btags pas nges par thub bo// jo bo rje'i gdams pa// ༈ 'brum srung rdo rje ma ni/ rgya shog la rgya snag gis rdo rje rtse gsum me 'bar ba bris pa'i yar gyi dbus rwar: phroṃ ni phaṭa: mar gyi dbus rwar: ru ta ni phaṭa: ces brtsegs mar mgo gyen bstan du bri: lte bar: oṃ ru ṇi phaṭa 'chang ba 'di la 'brum nad rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: zhes bri: rdzas ni gla rtsi: shu dag nag po: sgog skya'o: rab gnas byas la gsham nas dril: skud pa nag pos khyab par dkri: la chas btums shing mgul du gdags: dam tshig 'gom yug ma shor gces: mnga' bdag nyang gis phra mo brag nas spyan drangs pa'i las tshogs: : gter chen rdo rje'i phyag len ma'o// ༈ //'go nad srung ba'i 'khor lo ni/ ma dang mkha' 'gro rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor lo 'di gro shog la zla ba gang yang rung ba'i tshes gcig la bris nas/ gcig bsregs la gzhan rnams dud pa la bdug go /de'i thal ba'ang byug bya rgod spu dang nyung dkar btums/ lug skyis thum bya/ mgo la g.yon skor lan gsum/ de nas gong ba g.yon du gdags/ de nas tshes gcig nam byung 'khor lo bkrol nas mgo la chos skor lan gsum byas la gdags so// mkha' 'gro ma'i brda yig yin pas rab gnas mi dgos/ btags pas chog /sreg 'khor gro ga la bri'o// sgom dang dmigs pa gang yang med do// : bla ma pad+ma'i gdams pa'o// sarba maṅga laṃ/ shu bhaṃ/ ྈ rims srung za yig rin chen phun tshogs gter ma/ rdzas la khyung lnga byug /nangs snga gzhan dang ngag ma 'dres par za/ ā brgya brgya bzlas pas rab gnas bya/ bye ring las so/// /
